# OpenPersona

> Go library and HTTP service for persona and context engineering: long-term memory for AI agents (read-write) and trained, read-only personas backed by a knowledge graph. Pure Go, SQLite storage, no external services.

Module: `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona` (source: https://github.com/VicoAritonang/open-persona). Requires Go 1.26+.

## Packages

- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona` (root): the client library. `openpersona.Persona` is one interface for a hosted or a local persona: `ID()`, `Info(ctx)`, `Knowledge(ctx, query, KnowledgeOptions{Units, Sources})` (no LLM), `Chat(ctx, []Message, ChatOptions{Context, MaxTokens})`, `Stream(ctx, msgs, opt, func(delta string) error)`, `Close()`. Hosted: `openpersona.NewClient(apiKey, ClientOptions{BaseURL, StreamURL, ChatMode})` then `client.Persona("kora")` (Chat is async by default: a job, polled); `client.Download(ctx, id, dir)` / `client.OpenLocal(ctx, id, dir, LocalOptions{Chat})` fetch the pack. Local: `openpersona.Open(path, LocalOptions{Chat, Embedder, NoEmbeddings})`. `openpersona.NewKnowledgeTool(ctx, p, ToolOptions{})` returns a tool with `Name`, `Description`, `Parameters`, `Call(ctx, args)`, `OpenAI()`, `Anthropic()`. `openpersona.Ask(ctx, p, question)`.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/cloud`: `Principal` (key id, personas, scopes `knowledge`/`chat`/`download`), `Authenticator`, `StaticKey`, `AnyOf`, `JobStore`, `MemoryJobs`, `UsageRecorder`.

- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/memory`: `memory.New(memory.Config{Store, Extractor, Embedder, Reranker})` returns an `*Engine`. `Add(ctx, scope, []memory.Message)` stores messages; `Search(ctx, scope, query, memory.SearchOptions{})` returns `*Result` with `Facts`, `Episodes` and `Context(maxTokens) string`; `Flush(ctx)` waits for background extraction; `Close()` on shutdown.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/persona`: `persona.Trainer{LLM, Embedder, EmbedModel}.Train(ctx, persona.Spec, []persona.Source, outPath)` writes a frozen pack. `persona.Open(path)` returns a read-only `*Persona` with `Retrieve(ctx, query, persona.RetrieveOptions{})`, `SystemPrompt(*Knowledge) string` and `Chat(ctx, llm.Client, []llm.Message, persona.ChatOptions{Context})`.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/graph`: `graph.Open(path, graph.Options{ReadOnly, Analyzer})` returns the `*Store` both engines use.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/llm`: `llm.New("provider:model")` returns a client that implements both `llm.Client` and `llm.Embedder`. Providers: `openai`, `openrouter`. `llm.LoadDotEnv()` loads `.env`.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/recall`: `recall.Channel`, `recall.Fuse`, `recall.Rerank` for custom retrieval.
- `go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/server`: `server.Server{Memory, Personas | Catalog, Chat, APIKey | Auth, Jobs, Dispatch, Usage, AllowOrigins}.Handler()` returns an `http.Handler` with the REST API, SSE streaming and MCP (`POST /mcp`); `RunJob(ctx, id)` runs an async job. `registry.Catalog{Registry, Dir}` serves packs on demand from Neon; `*registry.Registry` implements `cloud.Authenticator`, `JobStore` and `UsageRecorder`.

## Rules for correct use

- Scope is the isolation boundary. Derive it from the authenticated session, never from model output.
- `Add` returns before facts are extracted. Call `Flush` only in tests and batch jobs.
- One `Engine` per database file, shared by all goroutines. Close the engine before the store.
- A persona pack is immutable. To change a persona, retrain and replace the file. Set `p.Embedder` to a client for `p.EmbedModel` when it is non-empty.
- A pack is versioned by `Spec.ID` and `Spec.Version` (semver). In the registry (`go.vicoworks.com/open-persona/registry`, Postgres/Neon) id@version is immutable: bump the version when retraining. `registry.Open(ctx, registry.URLFromEnv(), registry.Options{})`, then `Migrate`, `Push(ctx, path, PushOptions{})`, `Pull(ctx, id, version, outPath)` ("" = latest published). See docs/REGISTRY.md.
- `Spec.Retrieve` (`{"units": 20, "sources": 3}` in spec.json) sets a pack's default retrieval budget; `RetrieveOptions` still override it. Multi-sentence queries also retrieve per sentence. For agents, expose `POST /v1/personas/{name}/prompt` with `{"query", "units", "sources"}` as a knowledge tool called once per sub-question (see examples/travel/README.md).
- `Persona.Evaluate(ctx, []persona.EvalCase{{Q, Expect}}, persona.EvalOptions{})` scores whether expected facts reach the prompt, with no chat call; `Trainer.Eval` does it at training time and stores the result in the pack.
- Pass conversations to `Persona.Chat` without a system message; the persona supplies it. Put extra context (such as `Result.Context`) in `ChatOptions.Context`.
- `Result.Context` returns "" when nothing was found; do not add an empty memory block to prompts.
- Tests should use a fake `llm.Client` (a func type with a `Complete` method); see `memory/memory_test.go`.
